HUMAN IMAGINATION × AI

About JARVIS AI Music

JARVIS AI Music is a project exploring AI-assisted electronic music. This site brings together released videos, production notes and ways to share feedback. The releases are available on the JARVIS EDM Radio YouTube channel. Here, the aim is to make the work easier to explore: what has been released, what the production records tell us, and what remains a matter of listening and personal interpretation.

AI assistance is part of this project’s identity. It should not be mistaken for a named human performer, a live band or a claim that every track was made with the same tools. Where production details are available, the notes identify the particular release to which they apply. Measurements and file checks are not substitutes for a listening review.

Browse the released tracks, read the production notebook, or visit the community. Live radio is not currently active; the released videos remain available independently of any future live service.

THE PRODUCTION NOTEBOOK / 02

How sound becomes a visualizer

A documented example: Light Beyond Static

The production record for Light Beyond Static describes an instrumental in E minor at 136 BPM, with a source duration of approximately 2 minutes 31 seconds. It was rendered locally from oscillator and seeded-noise synthesis. In this process, oscillators provide repeating waveforms and seeded noise supplies reproducible noise signals; the arrangement combines these into the track. This description applies to this release, not automatically to every video in the catalogue.

The notebook records a first full drop at approximately 0:14, a breakdown at 0:42, a second build beginning around 1:11 and a second drop around 1:25. These are arrangement markers from the production data. You can use them to compare how the piece changes across sections; they are not conclusions from an independent listening review.

The video’s visualizer uses the actual master audio, rather than an unrelated looping animation. Each frame analyses a short window of sound using an FFT, a method for separating a signal into frequency components. The renderer groups the result into 112 logarithmically spaced bands between 40 Hz and 16 kHz. Logarithmic spacing gives lower frequencies more room than equally spaced frequency steps would. A separate pulse is driven by measured low-frequency energy between 35 Hz and 160 Hz.

The analysis window is centred on the audio sample corresponding to each frame. The image is rendered at 30 frames per second. Smoothing makes the display react and then settle instead of changing abruptly with every measurement. As you watch, consider the difference between a brief change in energy and a sustained one: a spectrum display shows energy over frequency, not the identity of every instrument or the meaning of the music.

Technical checks for the source master recorded -13.96 LUFS integrated loudness, -1.66 dBTP true peak and zero clipped samples. LUFS estimates programme loudness; true peak estimates peak levels between digital samples. These figures describe a checked file, not a promise of identical loudness on every device or after a platform re-encodes the video. The checks also covered complete file decoding and audio/video timing. No independent listening evaluation is claimed.

Watch Light Beyond Static on YouTube

Reading our production notes

We distinguish three things: production decisions recorded in project files, technical measurements of a particular output, and subjective listening impressions. A measurement can help catch a broken or clipped file, but it cannot prove that a song is enjoyable. Likewise, an AI-assisted workflow does not by itself establish that a work is unique or clear every possible third-party right.

When a note names tools, settings or timestamps, it is tied to the identified release. If records are not available, we leave the detail unspecified rather than inventing a studio session, a performer or a personal story. Catalogue descriptions and listening prompts help you explore; they are not guarantees about rights, suitability for reuse or commercial licensing.

KEEP IN TOUCH / 03

Contact, feedback and reuse

For public questions about a release, use the relevant video’s comments on the JARVIS EDM Radio channel. The JARVIS AI Music Discord community is another place to share feedback and music requests. Include the track title and, for a playback problem, the device/browser and approximate timestamp. Do not post passwords, payment details or other sensitive personal information in public channels.

  • YouTube / JARVIS EDM Radio ↗
  • Discord / JARVIS AI Music ↗

Requests and messages do not guarantee an immediate reply, a release date or acceptance of a commission. A public video or a public website source repository is not, by itself, a licence to reuse the music. No reuse or commercial licence is granted by this page. For a rights concern, identify the work, the relevant link and the issue without publicly disclosing sensitive documents.

YOUR VISIT / 04

Privacy and external services

Last updated: 24 October 2026.

This notice describes the website implementation reviewed for this update. The site stores your selected language in your browser’s local storage under jarvis-language. This preference is used to keep your selected interface language when you return. You can remove it through your browser’s site-data settings; doing so resets the saved preference.

A YouTube player is created when you open a track’s player. It uses YouTube’s privacy-enhanced embed domain, youtube-nocookie.com. Opening the player makes a connection to YouTube; privacy-enhanced mode is not a guarantee that no information is processed. You can instead follow the direct YouTube link, which takes you to that external service.

Google privacy policy

Discord and YouTube links take you to services operated by their respective providers. Your use of those services, including accounts, comments and messages, is governed by their policies.

Discord privacy policy

The project’s reviewed website files do not add an analytics tracker, an advertising script, a newsletter form or a site account system. This statement does not cover advertising inside YouTube, processing by the hosting service, or the policies of external services. Hosting the site necessarily involves handling web requests; this notice does not claim that the hosting provider keeps no technical logs.

If advertising or additional data collection is introduced later, this notice and any required consent controls must be updated before that processing begins. For a question about the site, use the public contact routes above and avoid sending sensitive information in public.
